key_facts: Anthropic opened its Singapore office on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026
MOU on AI cooperation signed Tuesday by co-founder Benjamin Mann and Chng Kai Fong, permanent secretary of the Ministry of Digital Development and Information
It covers AI safety, model evaluation, responsible adoption and incident response
Senior Minister K Shanmugam said Singapore wants "full transparency immediately" from major tech firms
Singapore signed similar deals with OpenAI (May) and Microsoft (June)
Anthropic did not share the size of the Singapore team; 12 jobs are listed
quote_evidence: The agreement covers AI safety, model evaluation, responsible adoption and incident response.

The MOU was signed on the sidelines of the Singapore International Cyber Week (SICW) conference on Tuesday by Anthropic co-founder Benjamin Mann and Mr Chng Kai Fong, permanent secretary of the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI).
why_it_matters_hint: A leading AI lab ties its safety work to a government that wants fast incident reporting.
title: Anthropic opens Singapore office, signs AI safety agreement with government
